reference: KitchenX Admin Jobs reference (platform hire dashboard, 2026-11 redesign): heading with Last 30 Days and Post a Job, one management card with status tabs (All / Active / Under Review / Paused / Closed / Drafts), toolbar filters (search, category, location, recruiter, status, posted-date calendar, orange Export), a ten-row jobs table (recruiter name under outlet, Applications / Hired) and labelled pagination; KPI cards, trend chart, Quick Actions and Jobs-by-Category removed. KitchenX Admin Applications reference (platform hire dashboard, 2026-11 redesign): heading, one management card with six status tabs, search and filters, a ten-row applications table and labelled pagination (Previous / numbered pages / Next); KPI cards, trend chart and Quick Actions removed. KitchenX Admin Recruiters reference (platform hire dashboard, 2026-11 redesign): heading with Export and Add Recruiter, one management card with three status tabs (All / Active / Inactive), toolbar (search, business type, location, status, Any time), a ten-row recruiters table (avatar + name, contact, company/outlet, verification, jobs posted, hired, last login, account status, view/edit/more) and labelled pagination; KPI cards, trend chart and Quick Actions removed. KitchenX Admin Job Seekers reference (platform hire dashboard, 2026-11 redesign): heading with Export and Add Job Seeker, one management card with three status tabs (All / Active / Inactive — Inactive includes Under Review and Suspended), toolbar (search, experience, location, status, Any time), a ten-row job seekers table (seeker id, avatar + name + email, contact, location, profile completion bar, applications, interviews, last active, account status, view/edit/more) and labelled pagination; KPI cards, trend chart and Quick Actions removed. KitchenX Admin Businesses / Outlets reference (platform hire dashboard, 2026-11 redesign): heading with Export and Add Business and subtitle Manage employer businesses, branches and outlet locations, one management card with three status tabs (All / Active / Inactive — Under Review and Suspended sit in All only), toolbar (search, business type, location, verification, status, Any time), a ten-row businesses table (business id, store tile + brand + location, business type, outlets, primary contact, verification independent of status, joined on date-only, account status, view/edit/more) and labelled pagination; KPI cards, trend chart and Quick Actions removed; Add/View/Edit stay as dialogs. KitchenX Admin User Management reference (platform hire dashboard, 2026-11 redesign): heading with Export and Add User and subtitle Manage platform staff, roles, access permissions, and account status, one management card with five status tabs (All Users / Active / Inactive / Pending / Suspended), toolbar (search, role, department, status, Last 30 Days), a ten-row users table (user id, avatar initials + name + email, role badge, department, access scope, last login, account status, view/edit/more) and labelled pagination; KPI cards, User Activity Trend and Quick Actions removed; Add/View/Edit stay as dialogs. KitchenX Admin Categories & Roles reference (platform management, 2026-11): a 1536x1024 picture with Audit Logs and Export, two stat cards (Total Categories, Total Roles), and a workspace with two tabs: Categories (Business Categories table with search, status filter and a 5-row pager beside the System Roles table) and Roles & Permissions (role picker and a module by View/Create/Edit/Delete/Export matrix; Super Admin and Admin are protected and read-only); Add, View and Edit open in dialogs. KitchenX Admin Reports & Analytics reference (platform hire reports, 2026-11): a 1672x941 picture (the 1600x900 design scaled by 1.045) with a Reports & Analytics heading, a date-range menu (Last 7, 30 or 90 Days, each with the dates it covers) and Export, five report pills (all five enabled), five stat cards (Jobs Posted, Applications, Hired, Rejected, Avg. Time to Hire, each with its change against the previous window), and the Hiring Trend, Applications by Status donut, Top Job Categories, Top Locations and Platform Growth (job seekers and recruiters on two value axes) cards, all on one screen scaled by its own unit; each of the five stat cards opens a detail view under the cards (a paginated list for Jobs Posted, Applications, Hired and Rejected, and a time-to-hire analysis for Avg. Time to Hire). KitchenX Admin Jobs Report reference (platform hire reports, 2026-11): the same scaled grid as Overview so every report tab shares identical card sizes, with five stat cards (Total Jobs, Active, Closed, Draft, Avg. Time to Fill), a Jobs Posted Trend area chart, a Jobs by Status donut (Active/Under Review/Paused/Closed/Draft), Top Job Categories, and a Recent Jobs table (Job ID, Job Title, Outlet/Business, Posted On, Applications, Status). KitchenX Admin Applications Report reference (platform hire reports, 2026-11): the same scaled grid as Overview and Jobs Report, with five stat cards (Total Applications, Shortlisted, Under Review, Hired, Rejected), an Applications Trend area chart, an Applications by Status donut (Hired/Shortlisted/Under Review/Rejected, same breakdown as Overview), Applications by Job Category, Applications by Location, and a Recent Applications table (App ID, Applicant, Job Title, Applied On, Status). KitchenX Admin Users Report reference (platform hire reports, 2026-11): the same scaled grid as the other report tabs, with five stat cards (Total Users, Job Seekers, Businesses/Outlets, Recruiters, New Users), a User Registration Trend area chart (the same six months as Overview's Platform Growth), a Users by Type donut (Job Seekers/Businesses/Outlets/Recruiters/Admins), Users by Location, and a Recent Users table (User ID, User Name, User Type, Registered On, Status). KitchenX Admin Recruiter Report reference (platform hire reports, 2026-11): the same scaled grid as the other report tabs, with five stat cards (Total Recruiters, Active Recruiters, Inactive Recruiters, New Recruiters, Avg. Hires per Recruiter — Total Recruiters is 312, the same count as Overview's Platform Growth and the Users Report tab), a Recruiter Activity Trend area chart (Jobs Posted and Hires), a Recruiters by Status donut (Active/Inactive/Suspended/Pending), Top Recruiters by Hires, and a Recent Recruiters table (Recruiter ID, Recruiter Name, Business/Outlet, Joined On, Jobs Posted, Hires, Status). KitchenX Admin Settings reference (platform configuration, 2026-11): a 1152x720 picture (the 1536x960 design scaled by 0.75) with a Settings heading and the line Platform configuration for KitchenX Hiring, Reset and Save Changes (both off until something changes), seven pills (General selected by default; Hiring & Jobs opens its own screen; Users & Roles, Notifications, Integrations, Security and Audit & Logs stay disabled until their screens exist), and four General cards on one screen scaled by its own unit: Platform Information, Platform Preferences, Hiring Configuration and System & Data. KitchenX Admin Hiring & Jobs Settings reference (platform configuration, 2026-11): a 1536x1024 picture with Hiring & Jobs selected and four cards in a 2x2 grid: Job Configuration (7 rows), Application & Interview Workflow (5 sections including interview-type checkboxes), Interview & Communication (4 rows) and Candidate & Job Preferences (4 rows). KitchenX Admin Notifications Settings reference (platform configuration, 2026-11): a 1536x1024 picture with Notifications selected and four cards in a 2x2 grid: Notification Channels (5 toggles), Notification Events (6 checkboxes), Notification Template (event/subject/message + Edit Template dialog), and Delivery Preferences (quiet hours, retry attempts, priority). KitchenX Admin Integrations Settings reference (platform configuration, 2026-11): a 1536x1024 picture with Integrations selected and two side-by-side cards: Connected Integrations (five rows — Email Service/SMTP, SMS Gateway, WhatsApp Business, Google Calendar, Google Maps — each with a coloured icon tile, a Connected/Not Connected pill and a Configure/Connect button; WhatsApp starts Not Connected) and Webhook (an Enable Webhook switch, a required Webhook URL field, and four event checkboxes: Job Created, Application Received, Interview Scheduled, Candidate Status Updated). KitchenX Admin Security Settings reference (platform configuration, 2026-11): a 1536x1024 picture with Security selected and two side-by-side cards, each at least 475px tall: Access & Authentication (five rows — Two-Factor Authentication switch, Password Policy Configure, Session Timeout dropdown, Failed Login Attempts dropdown, Account Lock Duration dropdown) and Additional Security (four rows — IP Restriction switch, Admin Access Control Configure, Login History View Logs, Active Sessions View Sessions). KitchenX Admin Audit & Logs Settings reference (platform configuration, 2026-11): a 1536x1024 picture with Audit & Logs selected and one full-width card, Audit Logs (a searchable, filterable table — Timestamp, User, Action, Module, Resource, Details, IP Address, Result — with Search, an All Modules dropdown, an All Actions dropdown, a date range, and Export; action pills Updated=yellow, Created=green, Deleted=red; a Success=green result pill; and pagination reading 1–5 of 248 logs).
